name: Cannalicious | 200mg RSO Recovery Gummies | Pear
description:
Pear
Sativa blend
200mg THC
10 Pieces
Activation time: 1-2 hrs.

Finally, an edible with all the benefits of the full cannabis plant! Named after a Canadian medical marijuana activist, Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a cannabinoid-rich, broad-spectrum extract that contains all the beneficial plant matter and is the most holistic cannabis concentrate available. These long-lasting Recovery RSO Gummies are easy to dose, and sativa enhanced with a pear flavor that contains THC, CBD, CBG, CBC and CBN to help promote a deep recovery of the mind and body. Activation time is 1-2 hours.
